headword: {伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}

definitions.explanation: Handmade crafts and artisanal products that have been passed down through generations, using traditional techniques and materials. In Japan, certain crafts are officially designated and protected by law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宝庫|ほうこ}→宝庫：17392_houko⟧だ。
examples.english: Kyoto is a treasure trove of traditional crafts.

examples.japanese: {伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えたい→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to pass on traditional craft techniques to the next generation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後継者|こうけいしゃ}→後継者：12592_koukeisha⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧で、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧しまう⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The shortage of successors is serious, and many traditional crafts are in danger of disappearing.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan officially designates certain crafts as {伝統的工芸品|でんとうてきこうげいひん} (traditional craft products) under the Traditional Craft Industries Promotion Act. Well-known examples include {輪島塗|わじまぬり} (Wajima lacquerware), ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧ (Arita porcelain), {西陣織|にしじんおり} (Nishijin weaving), and {江戸切子|えどきりこ} (Edo cut glass).

Many of these crafts face the challenge of ⟦{後継者|こうけいしゃ}→後継者：12592_koukeisha⟧{不足|ぶそく} (lack of successors), as younger generations often prefer other careers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}{品|ひん} (traditional craft product)
- {伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (traditional craft artisan)
- {伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to preserve traditional crafts)
- {伝統工芸|でんとうこうげい}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧ (traditional craft experience/workshop)
